text:
Review operational events without searching unrelated output. Keep named notice, warning and alert logs, and forward matching new entries. Start with list or read; each severity has its own bounded history.
write <log> <level> <text>: Keep one event and forward it to matching subscriptions. Matching sends finish before the reply.; returns: {entry:{id,level,text,at,last_at,count},deliveries:{matched,sent,dropped}}; role: write
  log (string): Case-sensitive log name: ASCII letters/digits, dot, underscore or hyphen; 1..64 characters
  level (string): notice, warning or alert
  text (string): One line, cleaned of controls and cut to 200 characters
read <log> [level]: Review retained events, newest first. Without a severity, show alert, warning and notice histories in that order.; returns: {log,rings:{alert:[],warning:[],notice:[]},counts:{alert:n,warning:n,notice:n},latest_alert_at,now}; selected rings only, counts all levels; latest_alert_at null when no live alert; role: read|write
  log (string): Case-sensitive log name: ASCII letters/digits, dot, underscore or hyphen; 1..64 characters
  level (string): notice, warning or alert
list: Find active logs, their entry counts and their latest retained alert time. Names are sorted.; returns: {logs:[{log,counts:{alert:n,warning:n,notice:n},latest_alert_at}],now}; role: read|write
[destructive] pull <log> [level] [count]: Take the oldest events out of a log and return them. Copies already sent to subscription destinations are unchanged.; returns: {log,entries:[],remaining,now}; oldest id first; removal durable before reply; role: write
  log (string): Case-sensitive log name: ASCII letters/digits, dot, underscore or hyphen; 1..64 characters
  level (string): notice, warning or alert
  count (int): Oldest entries to remove, 1..500; default 100; default: 100
[destructive] clean <log> [level] [id]: Delete events through an entry ID, or delete all selected events. Only deleting every severity without an ID boundary retires the log.; returns: {log,removed,counts:{alert:n,warning:n,notice:n}}; role: write
  log (string): Case-sensitive log name: ASCII letters/digits, dot, underscore or hyphen; 1..64 characters
  level (string): notice, warning or alert
  id (int): Inclusive entry upper id boundary; positive integer
sub add <target> [log] [level] [/regex/]: Receive matching new events from now on. In text, a single selector names a log, even if it is alert; JSON may select only a severity.; returns: {id,target,selector,filter,created_by,created_at,sent,dropped}; role: read|write
  target (string): Destination queue or agent; creator grants checked at add and every send
  log (string): Case-sensitive log name: ASCII letters/digits, dot, underscore or hyphen; 1..64 characters
  level (string): notice, warning or alert
  filter (string): Portable bare or /pattern/imsu regex, at most 200 scalar characters
sub list: Review your subscriptions. Direct Owners and Maintainers see all, including damaged rows marked invalid_state for repair.; returns: {subscriptions:[]}; role: read|write
[destructive] sub delete <id>: Stop your subscription. Direct Owners and Maintainers may delete any subscription, including damaged rows.; returns: {deleted:true}; role: read|write
  id (string): Subscription id: exactly 12 lower-case hexadecimal characters
status: Check health and the number of active logs in one line. Only direct readers, writers, Owners and Maintainers may use it.; returns: A truthful one-line status; role: read|write

Examples
agent-bus call '#eventlog@parf.us' list
agent-bus call '#eventlog@parf.us' 'sub list'

Docs: https://github.com/parf/ai-agent-bus/blob/main/docs/agents/eventlog.md
